title: Freelance Graphic Designer
summary: After teaching myself AutoCAD 2007 and CorelDRAW, I landed a freelance relationship with a graphics store, designing print and visual work under tight deadlines.
highlights: Designed graphic content for the store's clients in CorelDRAW and Photoshop.
Learned to manage my own time and deliver under pressure as a freelancer.
growth: Where my eye for layout and detail in UI comes from.
